reports.title: Scorpio Tankers Inc. Announces Financial Results for the Third Quarter of 2026 and An Increase to its Quarterly Dividend

lines: The 2026 $90.0 Million Credit Facility, which remains undrawn, is expected to be used to finance a portion of the purchase price of four scrubber-fitted MR newbuilding product tankers, one of which was delivered in July 2026 and the remaining three vessels expected for delivery in 2027.
